text: Wacoal Holdings Corp. (TSE code 3591) lists its major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 as The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account) (9.7%), Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company (6.17%), The Bank of Kyoto, Ltd. (4.76%), MUFG Bank, Ltd. (4.62%), Goldman Sachs International (3.55%), Nippon Life Insurance Company (3.18%), The Shiga Bank, Ltd. (3.17%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 3.17%) and Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation (3.08%).
short: Wacoal Holdings is Tokyo-listed; largest holders are Master Trust (9.7%) and Meiji Yasuda Life (6.17%).
